heroHeadline: 32 Days to Kickoff — Mbappé Out of El Clásico (Hamstring); Iran Issues 10-Point Ultimatum; Neymar in Brazil Preliminary Squad; Provisional Squad Deadline Tomorrow
heroSubtitle: Kylian Mbappé was officially ruled out of El Clásico (Barcelona vs Real Madrid at Camp Nou, May 10) due to a hamstring injury — the France captain's fitness is now the tournament's most significant pre-tournament concern, with Didier Deschamps naming France's 26-man squad in Paris on May 14. Barcelona won El Clásico and clinched La Liga. On the Iran front, FIFA Football Federation president Mehdi Taj issued a formal 10-point ultimatum on May 9 confirming Iran will 'definitely' compete — but only if the US, Canada, and Mexico satisfy conditions including visas for all players and staff (including those with prior IRGC service) and written security guarantees; Taj confirmed not a single US visa has been issued to any Iranian player or staff member with 32 days to kickoff. Iran's squad is set to depart for a training camp in Turkey on May 15 — contingent on visa issuance. Carlo Ancelotti included Neymar in Brazil's preliminary 55-man squad on May 9; Neymar must survive the final cut ahead of Ancelotti's May 18 announcement in Rio. The FIFA provisional squad deadline for all 48 nations is tomorrow, May 11. Next confirmed squad announcements: France on May 14, Sweden May 12, New Zealand May 14, Japan May 15, Brazil May 18, Germany May 21, USMNT May 26 at The Rooftop at Pier 17 NYC live on FOX Sports. The FIFA–Iran Zurich meeting on May 20 is the last formal diplomatic channel before the June 1 final squad deadline. 32 days to kickoff at Estadio Azteca.
